documents.title: Medication chart review

sections.heading: Reason for review
sections.text: A routine review of Jane Doe’s medication chart and recorded medicines was completed. The chart, dispensing history and patient-reported list were compared.

sections.heading: Review summary
sections.text: The example chart records amlodipine 5 mg once daily and metformin 500 mg twice daily with meals. Jane reports using a weekly organiser. Medication names, doses and indications were checked against the chart supplied for this fictional review.

sections.heading: Correspondence
sections.text: A copy of the review has been sent to Dr James Smith for reconciliation with the practice record. No prescription is issued by this sample document.

documents.title: Cardiology consultation letter

sections.heading: Dear Dr Smith
sections.text: Thank you for referring Jane Doe for a routine cardiovascular review. We discussed her medical history, usual activities and current medication list.

sections.heading: Consultation summary
sections.text: In this fictional consultation, Jane described occasional awareness of her heartbeat. A clinic examination and a resting ECG were recorded. No medication change is documented in this sample letter.

sections.heading: Correspondence
sections.text: The consultation findings and a copy of the ECG report have been forwarded to your practice for inclusion in Jane’s record.

documents.title: Sydney Labs — resting ECG

sections.heading: Investigation
sections.text: Resting 12-lead electrocardiogram. Requested by Dr James Smith for Jane Doe.

sections.heading: Recorded findings
sections.text: Example tracing: sinus rhythm at 72 beats per minute. PR interval 160 ms, QRS duration 88 ms and QTc 410 ms. These are fictional measurements supplied to demonstrate a report layout.

sections.heading: Report distribution
sections.text: Electronic report addressed to Dr James Smith. The sample tracing is described in text; no original ECG image is attached.

sections.text: Jane Doe attended for a routine foot and footwear assessment. Skin condition, nails, pressure areas and footwear fit were reviewed.

sections.heading: Assessment record
sections.text: This example records intact skin, a small callused area at the right forefoot and a discussion of her usual walking activities. A basic sensory screen and pedal pulse assessment were documented in the clinic notes.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: A copy of this fictional assessment is provided for your records. No new diagnosis or medication is established by this example.
